attempted_claim: Prove or disprove that the group-measure-space II_1 factor M = L^infinity(X) rtimes G_{5/2} for the Bernoulli free ergodic measure-preserving action of the Popa-Shlyakhtenko strongly treeable ICC group G_{5/2} of fixed cost 5/2 with L(G_{5/2}) isomorphic to the interpolated free group factor L(F_{5/2}) has its canonical Cartan subalgebra L^infinity(X) unique up to unitary conjugacy; this concerns the crossed product, which by construction has a Cartan, so no solidity theorem for the group factor L(G_{5/2}) itself decides it; the bounded one-hour attack checks the Popa-Vaes treeable-cocycle deformation-rigidity and intertwining hypotheses on the explicit Bernoulli generators at the fixed cost 5/2; a complete answer either proves uniqueness of L^infinity(X) by that transfer or exhibits a second Cartan subalgebra of M not unitarily conjugate to L^infinity(X), a new non-uniqueness witness for treeable-group measure-space factors.

Hence prior result substantively implies headline without stating 5/2 verbatim; this is recomputation/certificate/corollary/repackaging of known stronger fact. Timestamp or failed literal-title search cannot establish priority. Originality FAILS and is never repairable. value: Even though correctness passes, headline has no independent retrieval value under STANDARD. Cost 5/2 is an arbitrary finite slice / mere parameter substitution of the general t>1 rigidity theorem with no pre-computation motivation distinguishing 5/2 from any other t>1, no new boundary, no second-Cartan witness (disproof alternative false as predicted), no classification advance, and no demonstrated downstream need for this exact datum. Value was mechanically implied by Prop 4.7(b); certification by explicit arithmetic and re-chaining the published ME transfer does not create value. Falls under reject categories: mechanically implied, parameter substitution, arbitrary parameter fact. No bounded addition short of a new direction could rescue it.
